Interface MemoryInspector

All Known Implementing Classes:
RouxEngine
public interface MemoryInspector
The MemoryInspector is the read-only view of regions and counters. A caller can read a MemoryTelemetry snapshot. A caller can list the live regions. A caller can read one RegionDescriptor. A caller can copy a raw byte range. A caller can read a HealthReport. None of these calls change the stored frames. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#MemoryInspector roux-design.md

    • readRaw

      void readRaw(MemoryAddress address, MemorySegment dest)
      The method copies raw bytes into the caller's segment. The copy starts at the MemoryAddress. The copy stops at the end of the destination when the destination is shorter than the address.
      Parameters:
      address - The address is the source range.
      dest - The segment is the caller-provided destination.

      Returns:
      The report is a HealthReport.
